concerns.text: FR‑008 requires the use of a Wilcoxon signed‑rank test (or bootstrapped confidence intervals) on absolute errors for the comparison between Feature Set A and Feature Set B. The plan instead specifies a paired t‑test, which contradicts the functional requirement and the constitution’s cross‑material mediation validation principle.

Principle VII (Cross‑Material Mediation Validation) mandates that any claim of predictive improvement must demonstrate at least a 10 % lower MAPE for stress‑mediated models. The plan does not state this quantitative threshold, leaving the requirement unaddressed.
